constraint_results.judge_reason: It does recurse into nested dicts, but the audit log uses only the local `count` of redactions at the current level. Redactions performed in recursive calls are not added to the parent count, so `keys_redacted=count` is not the total number of keys redacted across all depths, and multiple audit events may be emitted (one per recursion) rather than a single total.
